en.name: Haley Strategic D3CRX Chest Harness (MultiCam)
en.description: The Haley Strategic D3CRX chest rig is one of the most highly regarded load-bearing systems among PMC operators. Its lightweight, straightforward design is complemented by an optimal setup of pouches. This version comes in MultiCam and is additionally equipped with a pull-out med pouch.

en.name: ANA Tactical M1 plate carrier (EMR)
en.description: The M1 vest is created with the use of the best experience of Russian special forces operators. The versatility of the system makes it possible to use this vest both when carrying out city tasks and when performing tasks on rough terrain. Equipped with additional pouches. Manufactured by ANA Tactical. EMR camouflage version.

en.name: Blue Force Gear PLATEminus V2 Plate Carrier (Scourge)
en.description: The second-generation plate carrier from Blue Force Gear is designed to accommodate SAPI/ESAPI-format plates. Made from a water-resistant material with reduced infrared signature. Quick-release buckles allow the carrier to be removed instantly in critical situations. Its reinforced construction provides reliable protection in any combat conditions. This version is an exact replica of the plate carrier worn by the mysterious Arena champion known as Scourge.
